kind: source-only independent causal research; existing PR #1327, Amalgam #1278 sole canonical owner; no first-use issue #426
question: Can a source-blinded posterior learner choose x2-enabling interventions from its own predicted value of information to disambiguate causal laws that are exactly indistinguishable under earlier action set? Is transferred sparse ANF prior helpful beyond a no-FIT candidate and full-capacity Bayes?

public_source.context: Three binary inputs x0,x1,x2. Per step initial c=t%4 so x2=0. Interventions actions a∈{0,1,2,3}, effective context c XOR (0,1,2,4)[a]. a3 flips x2. Earlier KNOW24 restricted to 0,1,2.
public_source.outcome: Exactly one witnessed y~Bernoulli(.85) when private f(effective)=1, else Bernoulli(.15). Private SHA256(seed,t) coin independent of chosen action. Private f/coin not a learner input.
public_source.fit: Three independent low-only FIT worlds under private x0, x1, xor01, 24 passive action0 witnessed observations each; learn an eight-coefficient ANF sparse prior through expected coefficient posteriors, same as KNOW24 on fresh FIT seeds.

candidate.hypotheses: All 256 Boolean three-input truth functions represented as 8 GF(2) ANF coefficients; sparse coefficient Bernoulli prior learned from 72 actual low-x2 FIT action outcomes, NOT supplied private FIT law labels.
candidate.choice: For each step t>=12 choose among public actions {0,1,2,3} the action maximizing expected reduction in posterior uncertainty of the 4 high-context causal bits (x2=1), averaged over the two possible future witnessed outcomes using existing posterior and known 0.85/0.15 observation noise; ties choose smallest action. No hidden truth, future witness, evaluator score or x2 oracle.
candidate.update: Bayesian log likelihood for each hypothesis from exactly the chosen current action's single reward; no all-actions/counterfactual pseudo labels.
candidate.cold: Cold checkpoint includes 256 posterior hypothesis probabilities/log weights, witnessed transcript, learned FIT prior, exact deterministic hash, typed source-only and replay negative controls. Prior FIT submodels never trained on HELD world outcomes.

controls: Same trained sparse ANF posterior with x2 action forbidden 0..2 (KNOW24 identifiability negative, same first 12 low observations)
Same trained sparse ANF with fixed action3 for last12 (exogenous x2 intervention; not a learned choice)
Same sparse ANF prior p_j=.25, no FIT, same active value-of-information action choice
Uniform exact Bayesian over 256 truth tables p_j=.5 with same active value-of-information policy (equal hypothesis count, different prior)
Known six paired operator hypothesis family Bayes, active VOI, EXTRA true law family structural prior (not equal capacity)
Fully fitted independent eight-context Beta(1,1) with same policy-level info-gain and 4 actions, updates only witnessed cells
Seeded deterministic public random choice among 4 actions, same trained sparse ANF predictor
Source-only p=.5 with fixed x2-blind actions, no training

eval.primary: Mean analytic EXPECTED Brier of four held high-context (c=4..7, action0) predictions per 24 worlds =96 queries, evaluated after 24 witnessed outcomes; evaluator private truth used only for scoring.
secondary: Exactly 12 same-seed paired low-law/high-law transcripts and predictions must match for a3-barred model; original paired high Brier>=.25
Rate of model-chosen x2-flipping actions among 288 allowed active interventions after step12
High forecast divergence across paired-world twins when a3 is allowed (no guarantee due to Bernoulli noise)
Held per-pair expected Brier and compare no-FIT/uniform/known-family/forced-x2/random/beta
Original FIT ANF coefficient posteriors unchanged after 24 HELD world updates and exact cold restoration
Equal per-policy 72 FIT actions, 576 HELD actions (though chosen actions and observed evidence differ as adaptive consequence), scorer-only high 96 expected Brier queries
Execution time, checkpoint bytes, and observation/hypothesis-update counts, no whole-process speed benefit claim

frozen_decisions.H1: All 12 x2-barred same-seed paired worlds have byte-identical witnessed action/outcome traces and high-context predictions (non-identifiability negative)
frozen_decisions.H2: Trained candidate selects x2 intervention on at least 144/288 post-warmup allowed action opportunities, without a private rule label
frozen_decisions.H3: Trained candidate high expected Brier improves vs same trained x2-barred model by >=.020000 absolute across 96 high-context queries
frozen_decisions.H4: Trained candidate beats equal-hypothesis uniform full Bayes active high Brier by >=.010000
frozen_decisions.H5: Trained sparse ANF prior beats same architecture NO FIT x2-enabled by >=.010000 high Brier
frozen_decisions.H6: At least 8 of 12 paired-world high forecasts diverge L1 mean >=.05 when trained candidate has permitted x2 probes; not statistically population significant
frozen_decisions.verdict: All 6 criteria: DEV_MECHANISM_DISCOVERY_SUPPORTED. Any positive: DEV_MIXED_X2_DISCOVERY. Zero: DEV_NO_GO. Scientific outcome ALWAYS SCIENTIFIC_NO_GO_SYNTHETIC. Report H1 engineering safeguard separately.

requirements: No hidden operator label or action mask beyond declared affordances. Never silently give x2 access to barred arm. All active learners have 256 hypotheses except clearly separate contextual Beta and true-family-informed stronger prior; fair comparisons require interpreted differences in observed action information, prior/capacity and inference CPU. Freeze seeds, threshold, source, action budget and scoring before results. Synthetic only. Existing 6-job Linux/Windows focused, G29 seal, mandatory final regression and already-consumed original TRAIN image compatibility. No new scheduler, runner, controller, owner first-use/merge, paid API, model integration or checkpoint promotion.
